required_fields: Clinical phenotypes reported in affected individuals with Spinocerebellar ataxia 52 (RAB3A), including the verbatim wording from the paper and corresponding standard HPO term if identifiable
Phenotype frequencies given as exact numerators and denominators per assessed cohort (not percentages alone), attached to the specific cohort and a resolvable source (PMID or DOI)
Most discriminating findings that are present in most affected individuals but uncommon in disorders usually confused with SCA52
Names of the disorders usually confused with SCA52 and the level of confidence in distinguishing SCA52 from them based on discriminating findings
Clinical findings that were looked for and found absent in affected individuals (findings whose presence argues against the diagnosis of SCA52)
Evaluation of whether the SCA52 phenotype differs by variant type, variant position, age, or sex
Any clinical findings reported by one paper and explicitly contradicted by another
